title: Can Verizon's Disaster Preparedness Boost Customer Satisfaction?
author: Na
description: Verizon is mobilizing its network infrastructure and emergency response resources ahead of Tropical Storm Edouard in the Gulf. The company has positioned backup generators, portable power systems, and satellite connectivity to maintain communications for communities in Houston, Southeast Texas, and Southwest Louisiana. Verizon's Frontline Crisis Response Team, composed of former first responders and military personnel, is on standby to support public safety agencies at no cost.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Verizon is demonstrating proactive disaster preparedness with comprehensive infrastructure investments including backup generators, portable power systems, and satellite connectivity. The company's dedicated Frontline Crisis Response Team and commitment to supporting public safety agencies at no cost reflects strong operational readiness and customer-focused crisis management.

title: AT&T Benefits From Margin Expansion: Can the Trend Last?
author: Na
description: AT&T's Q2 results show improved profitability with adjusted EBITDA margin expanding to 39.1% and operating income rising 8.3% year-over-year. The company is on track to achieve $4 billion in annual cost savings by 2028 through network modernization and legacy copper network shutdown. Wireless gains, fiber growth, and service bundling are driving customer growth, while competitors Verizon and T-Mobile also report resilient performance despite market challenges.

title: ISSA VEO Conference Heads to Dallas During National Hispanic Heritage Month to Empower the Next Generation of Industry Leaders
author: Issa
description: ISSA announces the 2026 VEO Conference returning to Dallas on September 28-29, focusing on empowering Hispanic professionals in the cleaning and facility solutions industries. The second annual event will feature keynote speaker Cherian Thomas from T-Mobile, bilingual education, leadership development, and networking opportunities centered on financial literacy, professional growth, and technology mastery.

title: Cellhub Earns 3 Major ‘26 Channel Media Accolades, Recognizing its Value as a Unique Connectivity Services Provider
author: Suzanne Mattaboni Communications
description: Cellhub, a 5G connectivity provider and Primary Agent for T-Mobile, has received three major industry accolades in 2026: CEO Andy Sinha was featured in CRN's CEO Outlook, Director of Partner Marketing Cindy Tank-Murphy was named to CRN's Women of the Channel list, and the company won ChannelVision magazine's Visionary Spotlight Award. These honors recognize Cellhub's expanding managed services portfolio, leadership in 5G/6G-ready connectivity solutions, and growing market presence serving healthcare, retail, and enterprise sectors.

title: T-Mobile Fell 11% on an Earnings Beat, Then Rebounded 6% the Next Day. Here's What's Going On.
author: Daniel Sparks
description: T-Mobile experienced significant volatility following its Q2 earnings report on July 23-24, 2026. The stock initially fell 10.75% despite beating profit expectations, then rebounded 5.67% the next day. While the company reported 9% service revenue growth and raised its free cash flow guidance to $18.4-18.8 billion, investors were concerned about slower expected account additions in Q3 due to planned rate plan migrations. The author argues the rebound was justified, as the company's core fundamentals—service revenue growth, 10% EBITDA growth, and improved cash forecasts—remain intact.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Despite initial market disappointment, T-Mobile's fundamentals remain strong with 9% service revenue growth, raised free cash flow guidance ($18.4-18.8B), maintained full-year guidance, 10% EBITDA growth, and a reasonable valuation at 14x forward earnings with a 10% free cash flow yield. The Q3 slowdown is temporary and deliberate due to planned rate plan migrations, not a sign of business deterioration.
